known_limitations: Outcome-blind by design: deliberately NOT read any evidence/ or runtime/ directory in any worktree; the V2 worktree (.worktrees/jev-regime-router-v2/**); rsmv1/attribution.py; rsmv1/feasibility.py; rsmv1/arms.py; rsmv1/engine.py; rsmv1/data.py; decision caches (data_local/*.jsonl); no backtest result, PnL, fold return, or winner/loser information of any kind was sought or used.
Design inputs were the dispatch brief, regime definitions, and repo design-side conventions only (rsmv1/indicators.py, rsmv1/strategies.py docstring, freezes/*.json) — all convention, no data.

All parameters are convention-frozen (Turtle 20/10 Donchian, Wilder ATR14, 3.0x/0.5x ATR stop multipliers, EMA20/50, SMA20, 24-regime-bar event horizon, min-hold 6 regime bars); none tuned to any data, and none could have been.

The single new optional element vs the predecessor baseline mapping is DIS-FAILED-HIGH-S (BTCUSDT DISTRIBUTION); A1 may map DISTRIBUTION->FLAT for BTCUSDT to reproduce the baseline exactly. A4 records no outcome information for or against either choice.

The handoff artifact itself is committed in a separate follow-up commit (it contains commit_sha, so it cannot be inside its own commit); the focused deliverable commit is 7a7dc4fb877b98614a1eeaac59668265799a7142.
